title: Q with the order axioms is consistent, by exhibiting a model
statement: There is no derivation of falsity from the thirteen axioms of FO.Qle -- Robinson's seven plus the six order axioms -- in the first-order natural-deduction calculus: Not (FO.Provable FO.Qle FO.Formula.bot). The proof is soundness applied at the ℕ structure with the constant-zero valuation, exactly as for FO.Q: a derivation of bot from Qle would give FO.sat Nat FO.natStructureQ FO.Formula.bot v, which iota-reduces to False.

evidence.supports: FO.Qle.consistency is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement, and rests on no axiom. The proof term is one line: fun d => FO.soundness Nat FO.natStructureQ FO.Qle FO.Formula.bot d (fun _ => Nat.zero) (FO.Qle.natModels (fun _ => Nat.zero)).
evidence.notes: The ℕ structure is doing real work: an arbitrary FO.Structure M would not do, because M could be empty and the argument still needs a valuation Nat -> M to exist.

evidence.supports: The type is rebuilt from FO.Provable, FO.Qle and FO.Formula.bot inside the test and compared by Kernel::def_eq rather than by rendering, with a negative control that the SAME statement over FO.Q -- which is fo_robinson.rs's already-landed FO.Q.consistency -- is a DIFFERENT type. So a fact that had silently degraded to the strictly weaker statement about the smaller theory is a failure here.

provenance.source: authored from the roadmap item; the soundness route is fo_soundness.rs's, applied at the larger context

prior_art.what: the finitely axiomatised essentially undecidable arithmetic Q
prior_art.where: R. M. Robinson, 'An essentially undecidable axiom system', Proc. ICM 1950, vol. 1, 729-730
prior_art.attribution: standard textbook attribution; this lane did not consult the primary source

notes: This is a strictly stronger consistency statement than F:fo-q-consistency, over a strictly larger theory, and it is what a later Gödel-I slice would need: the order axioms are exactly the ones that make the uniqueness half of representability reachable, and an incompleteness argument has to be about a theory that can represent its own syntax. As with FO.Q, the proof is model-theoretic and lives in the metatheory, so it is exactly the kind of consistency proof Qle cannot carry out about itself.
